metadata.description: ELEVATE 2026 — release-level documentation reconciliation and sprint hygiene agents.

plugins.name: release-reconciler
plugins.description: Reconciles documentation against everything shipped since the last release tag. Opens one gated PR with a doc-debt ledger.

plugins.name: jira-sprint-nudge
plugins.description: Scans the current sprint for issues with no (or near-empty) description and asks the reporter to add one. Skips issues already nudged.
